mentions.name: Pahunchi
mentions.description: This app helps women feel safer by simulating a realistic incoming phone call they can pretend to answer when alone in a cab or getting out of a bad date. During the call an AI responds in the user's language (currently Hindi and English), and the user can share their location and include a voice note.
mentions.problem: Women alone in cabs or on bad dates may need a discreet, believable excuse to exit the situation and let others know where they are.
mentions.audience: Women who need a safe way to handle being alone in a cab or leaving a bad date.
mentions.source_excerpt: A free app for women to pretend to be on call when alone in a cab or to get out of a bad date. Can share location, voice note on a realistic call where AI responds in your language (currently supports Hindi, English).

evidence.value: A free app for women to pretend to be on call when alone in a cab or to get out of a bad date. Can share location, voice note on a realistic call where AI responds in your language (currently supports Hindi, English).
